description: s8-confluence-v38 (SLS v1.0.16): `displaced` is SLS 3.5's grade of a break inside the impulse leg the A3 pullback retraces, on the break's own candles, in the break's direction, read once for F1's +18 and A3. Each mutation puts back one way the grade could drift, including the v24-v37 leg reading. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/displaced_break_candle.json Also: SLS 5.1 Edge (3) -- one zone per (type, polarity, band) before stack counting.

mutations.name: the leg's displacement grades every break in it again (v24-v37)
mutations.new: displaced_record = next((r for r in events if r.event_type == f"BOS_{direction}" and (lambda leg: leg is not None and leg.displaced and legs.span(leg)[0] <= r.event_at <= legs.span(leg)[1])(legs.latest(LegKind.IMPULSE, direction))), None)

mutations.name: the candle before the break is not considered
the candle after the break is considered instead of the one before
direction ignored: any displacement candle grades the break
the leg scope is dropped: any break in the window can grade

mutations.name: the oldest displaced break in the leg is named, not the newest
F1's displaced evidence names the newest break instead of the one that earned it
a displacement's direction is mapped the wrong way round
zones counted raw again (an OB stored twice is a stack)
dedup over-reaches: every same-polarity zone collapses
the weaker row of a duplicated band is kept
